name: Dou Rong
alt: Dou Rong of the Hexi Corridor

predecessors.name: Xin dynasty
predecessors.text: Dou Rong: 'independently controlled the modern western Gansu and northern Qinghai region, west of the Yellow River'

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Dou Rong: 'independently controlled the modern western Gansu and northern Qinghai region, west of the Yellow River'

ledger.x: 23: Dou Rong holds the Hexi Corridor.
36: Dou Rong's Hexi ends in the Eastern Han's unification (25 December 36 for China proper, Guangwu footnote).

certainty.note: Only the modern region is named; the Hexi page gives four commanderies.
